name: Doc's RV Park
description: Doc's RV Park is a quiet, cozy retreat located amid stately oaks with Spanish moss, just beyond the center of Gulf Shores, AL. We are a family friendly park with 62 RV sites, 13 park model homes, a clubhouse with kitchen, outdoor swimming pool, playground, horseshoe pit and volleyball net. Doc's is located just 3 short miles from public beaches, restaurants and other local attractions. Whether you're passing through for a short stay, vacationing with your family or planning a seasonal stay, we have accommodations for you. Doc's RV Park is located away from the busy traffic of downtown yet within walking or biking distance to local beaches, shopping, restaurants and family activities.
